description: Converts annotations between formats: 'native' (smart_labeler's own JSON), COCO, YOLO, and GeoPackage. Runs inline in the backend (design-time only, no Tapis job — conversion is data reshaping, not a compute job). GeoPackage output is NOT geo-referenced (no camera GPS/FOV model here) — it writes plain image-pixel-space geometry in one 'annotations' layer; use the 'geospatial' step for a real map-projected GeoPackage. YOLO assumes a flat label directory whose file stems match the image directory's file stems 1:1.

outputs.name: converted
outputs.description: Points at whatever 'path' was saved to. Actual content depends on to_format: a JSON file (native/coco), a directory of .txt + classes.txt (yolo), or a binary .gpkg file (geopackage) — the declared 'json_results' type is a placeholder, not a literal guarantee, since this step's output shape varies by user choice.

system.description: Tapis system the converted output is written to.

path.description: Destination Tapis path for the converted output — a file path for native/coco/geopackage, a directory path for yolo.

from_format.description: Source format. 'native' or 'coco' read from the wired 'annotations' input; 'yolo' reads 'annotations_dir' + 'images'; 'geopackage' reads 'annotations_gpkg'.

to_format.description: Destination format. 'coco' and 'yolo' additionally need the wired 'images' input, to read each referenced image's pixel dimensions.
